_comment: Parameter-level tool policy enforced at the tool boundary in hardened mode and by evaluate_kpi.py --scan. Every tool listed here is permitted; the policy bounds HOW it may be called. 'max_calls' is the per-run call budget (executed calls only). 'max_limit' caps query_ledger's row limit. 'destinations' is the export allowlist and 'max_rows' caps the rows one export may carry. The gate reads the call's real parameters, never the model's prose.
